That will give your team actionable next steps.

- Prework: sample prompt set + a brief security checklist (we'll share templates)
- Outcomes: mutual action plan, target metrics, and a proposed env for a 2-week POC

I see your original windows are Dec 8–9; our exec and one of our engineering leads are traveling that week. Would the week after work (we have slots on Dec 15 12:00–15:00 EST or Dec 16 09:00–12:00 PST)? If those don't work, share a couple of times and we'll adapt.

I'm looping in Marissa Cole (solutions lead) to coordinate an agenda and Marcus Lin (engineering) will lead the architecture deep dive (copied below on internal thread).

If you'd like to stick with the shorter demo for a broader audience first, we can still do that and follow up with a separate scoping session — I just want to ensure your CTO gets the detailed answers they need.

Best,
